title: Guidance on the verification of hearing devices using probe microphone measurements
authors: British Society of Audiology
supports: 已读32页文件的术语、信号、校准、开放验配、REAR、输出、RECD及频率降低相关部分；是2018年指导，未声称新发布标准全文核读。

title: Hearing Aids For Adults
authors: American Speech-Language-Hearing Association
year: 网页未标单一出版年；2026-10-11核对
supports: 已读真耳测量、言语映射、功能验证与效果评价相关部分；成人范围。

title: Effect of probe tube insertion depth on spectral measures of speech.
authors: Caldwell M, Souza PE, Tremblay KL.
supports: 原始摘要；10名正常中耳成人，以耳模内端为参照的不同探管位置及言语频谱分析，不把位置差直接当作统一鼓膜距离。

title: Use of forward pressure level to minimize the influence of acoustic standing waves during probe-microphone hearing-aid verification.
authors: McCreery RW, Pittman A, Lewis J, Neely ST, Stelmachowicz PG.
supports: 原始摘要；两个实验中的高频驻波及前向声压方法，区别可靠性、准确性及测量坐标。

title: Reliability of real ear insertion gain in behind-the-ear hearing aids with different coupling systems to the ear canal.
authors: Jespersen CT, Møller KN.
supports: 已读全文方法、讨论与结论相关部分并核对摘要；10名正常听力成人20耳、五类耦合、两名测量者，结果有协议和样本限制。

title: Development and analysis of an International Speech Test Signal (ISTS).
authors: Holube I, Fredelake S, Vlaming M, Kollmeier B.
supports: 原始摘要；ISTS的自然言语属性、分段重混及百分位测量，不作为言语理解测试。

title: Clinical protocols for hearing instrument fitting in the Desired Sensation Level method.
authors: Bagatto M, Moodie S, Scollie S, Seewald R, Moodie S, Pumford J, Liu KP.
supports: 本次核对原始摘要与元数据；DSL的听阈和声学转换框架，具体RECD条件另以官方指导与原始研究核对。

title: RECD Measurements
authors: Boys Town National Research Hospital
year: 网页未标单一出版年；2026-10-11核对
supports: 已读个体与年龄预测、耦合匹配、负值排查、耳侧差异及更新RECD相关部分；不照录探管插入操作。

title: Using the Real-Ear-to-Coupler Difference within the American Academy of Audiology Pediatric Amplification Guideline: Protocols for Applying and Predicting Earmold RECDs.
authors: Moodie S, Pietrobon J, Rall E, Lindley G, Eiten L, Gordey D, Davidson L, Moodie KS, Bagatto M, Haluschak MM, Folkeard P, Scollie S.
supports: 原始摘要；18成人17儿童及模拟耳，泡沫耳塞和耳模管长的系统差异与转换修正。

title: Comparison of real-ear to coupler difference values in the right and left ear of hearing aid users.
authors: Munro KJ, Howlin EM.
supports: 原始摘要；成人及儿童两耳RECD比较，结论限定正常中耳与非阻塞耳垢条件，不视为两耳恒等。

title: Real-Ear-to-Coupler Difference: Physical and Perceptual Differences.
authors: Jorgensen L, Barrett R, Jedlicka D, Messersmith J, Pratt S.
supports: 原始摘要；退伍军人诊所老年成人个体/平均RECD组比较与自评结局，未声称随机试验。

title: Open Versus Closed Hearing-Aid Fittings: A Literature Review of Both Fitting Approaches.
authors: Winkler A, Latzel M, Holube I.
supports: 综述摘要；开放与封闭耦合的直接声、堵耳、反馈及信号处理权衡，不当作单一设备疗效试验。

title: The value of routine real ear measurement of the gain of digital hearing aids.
authors: Aazh H, Moore BC.
supports: 原始摘要；42耳、四类当时的数字助听器、NAL-NL1初始与调整后REIG，不能代表现代软件的统一失败率。

title: Characteristics of hearing aid fittings in infants and young children.
authors: McCreery RW, Bentler RA, Roush PA.
supports: 原始摘要；195名儿童、四频RMS目标误差、SII与个体/平均RECD关联，不将统计判据视为全年龄验配容差。

title: Comparing criteria for deviation from hearing aid prescriptive targets in children.
authors: Wiseman KB, Walker EA, Spratford M, Brennan M, McCreery RW.
supports: 原始摘要；307儿童2314次验证记录，<3、3—5、>5 dB RMS组与可听性和语言指标；2024年期刊发表，DOI含2023，非随机分配容差试验。

title: Differences in Word and Phoneme Recognition in Quiet, Sentence Recognition in Noise, and Subjective Outcomes between Manufacturer First-Fit and Hearing Aids Programmed to NAL-NL2 Using Real-Ear Measures.
authors: Valente M, Oeding K, Brockmeyer A, Smith S, Kallogjeri D.
supports: 原始摘要；24名新使用成人、双盲随机交叉、每设置四周，安静词/音素改善及HINT/SSQ未显著需分别报告。

title: Does Probe-Tube Verification of Real-Ear Hearing Aid Amplification Characteristics Improve Outcomes in Adults? A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
authors: Almufarrij I, Dillon H, Munro KJ.
supports: 已读全文讨论、结论及摘要；六项纳入五项合并，主要生活质量结局缺失、短期随访、处方与比较条件差异。

title: Listening Preferences of New Adult Hearing Aid Users: A Registered, Double-Blind, Randomized, Mixed-Methods Clinical Trial of Initial Versus Real-Ear Fit.
authors: Almufarrij I, Dillon H, Adams B, Greval A, Munro KJ.
supports: 本次核对原始摘要；45名新使用者、两个程序均按即时反馈调整，偏好与声学匹配分别解释。

title: The Effect of Real Ear Target Deviations on SSQ and Speech Intelligibility in a Clinical Population.
authors: Lansbergen SE, Dingemanse G, Versfeld NJ, Dreschler WA, Goedegebure A.
supports: 已读原文方法、结果、讨论和限制相关部分；298成人单中心回顾队列、资料采于2015—2019、仅65 dB SPL目标验证，关联不当作REM优化的随机因果效果。

title: A preliminary investigation into hearing aid fitting based on automated real-ear measurements integrated in the fitting software: test-retest reliability, matching accuracy and perceptual outcomes.
authors: Denys S, Latzel M, Francart T, Wouters J.
supports: 原始摘要；10名听损者、平衡单盲交叉，自动目标匹配、可靠性和可听性改善，言语理解未改善，需扩大样本。

title: Gain Analysis of Self-Fitting Over-the-Counter Hearing Aids: A Comparative and Longitudinal Analysis.
authors: Knoetze M, Manchaiah V, Cormier K, Schimmel C, Sharma A, Swanepoel W.
supports: 原始摘要；六款自助OTC的43人横断与15人纵向子研究，用户选择增益与NAL-NL2偏差，未证明所有设备的功能效果。

title: The Speech Intelligibility Index: Tutorial and Applications for Children Who Are Deaf and Hard of Hearing.
authors: Wiseman KB, Sapp C, Stiles D, Walker EA, McCreery RW.
supports: 教程摘要；儿童SII的计算框架、可听性用途及案例，不把SII当作识别正确率。
